Name: Pet Following
Author: ailicili1111
Description:
宠物现在可以跟随了. 无碰撞体积.
your pet now follows you to where ever you go. without blocking you of course.

可以配合我另一个Mod “Pet Carrying Inventory"， 这样你就得到了鸭科夫小狗的背包体验！
Work with my other mod “Pet Carrying Inventory", to create a Duckov pet backpack experience!

Manifest.Name: Pet Following
Manifest.Description: Keeps the farm pet close across maps at 75% of the farmer's movement speed and prevents pet-character collision.
Manifest.Author: Alice
